visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling timeline of milestone slides with prev/next navigation
visualCharacteristics.description: Interactive sliding component with repeating slides.

contentPattern.description: 9 timeline slides (2025, 2005, 2004, 1995, 1985, 1985, 1980, 1969, 1936), each icon + year + milestone, with prev/next navigation
contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cells: icon image, text (year paragraph + h3 milestone)

reuseGuidance: Use for ordered sequences of short cards that should scroll horizontally. The first link-free paragraph is styled as the year/eyebrow.
